title: A Busy Thursday
setting: A family house: a messy bedroom and a sunny kitchen.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

sentences.en: Ben wakes up at seven o'clock on Thursday.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) wakes up in bed and stretches, an alarm clock ringing on the bedside table, morning light at the window.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben waking up to a ringing alarm clock; the exact time and the day Thursday can't be shown.

sentences.en: His clothes are all over the bedroom floor.
sentences.zh: 他的衣服扔得卧室地板上到处都是。
sentences.scene_prompt: A messy bedroom with shirts, trousers and socks all over the floor; Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) stands in the middle of it.

sentences.en: He only has ten minutes for breakfast.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) eats breakfast in a hurry at the kitchen table, his school bag already on his back.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben eating breakfast in a hurry; 'only ten minutes' can't be shown.

sentences.en: His mother Anna cuts oranges for juice.
sentences.zh: 他妈妈安娜切橙子榨果汁。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) cuts oranges on a chopping board next to a juicer in a sunny kitchen.

sentences.en: She lets him use her new blue cup.
sentences.zh: 她让他用她的新蓝杯子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) hands a shiny new blue cup to Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) at the kitchen table.

sentences.en: Ben loves orange juice, even in winter.
sentences.zh: 本很爱喝橙汁，就连冬天也喝。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) happily drinks a big glass of orange juice by a window with snow falling outside.

sentences.en: After a month, he feels very strong.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，他觉得自己很强壮。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) proudly shows the muscles of his arm and smiles, a glass of orange juice on the table beside him.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben proudly showing his strong arm; 'after a month' can't be shown.
